what: Each time a pointer enters a product card, the next image in the photo slot fills from the bottom of the slot, height 0 → 100% over .7s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), covering the current one (starting .1s after entry) — the current image stays underneath, and the inner picture stays pinned to the slot bottom without moving while only the clipped height grows. It does not revert on leave, so each entry advances to the next image, and entries during the fill are ignored. On first attach, the first image also fills once.

options.[data-fx-part=frame] > [data-fx-part=pho: A photo cell and the sections (two or more) overlapping inside it — the cell needs a fixed height like aspect-ratio (the image inside a section is 100cqh)
options.delay: Delay until the hand enters and filling begins (s), default .1

use: …
note: On devices without hover (hover false) and with reduced motion, the first sheet stays as is

from.where: index.html .mw-card (two-column product grid, 14 cells) — original .c-designer-li: when the mouse enters, the current picture gets is-back, and 100ms later the next picture gets is-current → keyframes di (height 0→100%) .7s var(--2016-ease)=cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), photo is absolute pinned to bottom 0
